subject: Clarify signer provenance & PO ACK window for procurement portal registration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Holden <claire.holden@medsupply.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify signer provenance & PO ACK window for procurement portal registration

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. We want to keep momentum on MedSupply's onboarding and have a couple of items where we need confirmation before we push the MSA/order form into signature and finish portal provisioning (Ariba/Coupa). Attaching our annotated MSA and the vendor intake packet you shared.

Short asks:
- Signer provenance: who will sign on behalf of MedSupply (legal entity name + title). We need confirmation that the signer has authority for both the MSA and the order form (some buyers require separate signatories and that creates PO routing issues).
- PO acknowledgement SLA: our standard onboarding assumes vendors ACK PO within 72 hrs (T+3) for Ariba/Coupa. Some clients require T+48 or immediate ACK. Do you have a preference/requirement from your procurement team?
- Evidence: outstanding insurance cert + W9/tax form. We have the insurance cert you uploaded but it doesn't reference the current policy term — can you provide insurer contact and effective dates?
- Portal choice & EDI prefix: if you plan to use Ariba vs Coupa we need EDI prefix and whether your team will accept e-signature antecedents (DocuSign) for the order form acceptance.

Markus (legal) and Vanessa (onboarding) are CC'd — Markus has suggested a narrow redline for the liability clause; Vanessa will need final signer name to configure the signer matrix in the portal. Mateo, can you flag any model-serving/data-flow items that would affect compliance?

Next steps: if you can send the signer name/title, updated insurance cert and confirm PO ACK SLA by EOD Wed (5/4) we'll queue the DocuSign envelope and request portal provisioning.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0194

Attachments: MedSupply_annotated_MSA_20270502.pdf (redline), MedSupply_vendor_packet_20270502.zip (vendor docs)

From: Claire Holden <claire.holden@medsupply.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Wu <tim.wu@valencehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify signer provenance & PO ACK window for procurement portal registration

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the redline — appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers below: 

- Signer: our CFO, Claire Holden (same as sender), will sign the MSA and order form. Title: Chief Financial Officer, MedSupply Inc. We confirm one signer for both documents.
- PO ACK SLA: our procurement prefers T+48 for acknowledgements. We can accept T+72 for certain buyers but would like T+48 as the default.
- Insurance: attached is the certificate with the insurer contact; effective dates are 2027-04-01 to 2028-04-01. Note: the certificate lists MedSupply Inc. DBA "MedSupply" — legal entity is MedSupply Inc.
- Portal/EDI: we're currently set up on Coupa. EDI prefix for PO ingestion is MSPL. We accept DocuSign signatures for order forms — procurement requires audit trail but not wet signature.

I attached the updated insurance certificate and the vendor packet. Let me know if you need a W9 — we can provide that today.

Best,
Claire
Claire Holden
CFO, MedSupply Inc.
claire.holden@medsupply.com | (617) 555-6620

Attachments: MedSupply_insurance_CERT_20270430.pdf, MedSupply_vendor_packet_20270502.zip

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Claire Holden <claire.holden@medsupply.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clarify signer provenance & PO ACK window for procurement portal registration

Claire / Marissa —

Thanks — Claire, that clears up signer authority. A couple of legal notes after a quick pass over the annotated MSA: 

1) Indemnity carve: MedSupply's proposed language broadens indemnity to subcontractors. We're willing to accept a mutual indemnity with carveouts for third-party open-source claims and for breaches resulting from Redwood's exploitation of customer-provided data. Proposed compromise attached as a one-page insert (see MedSupply_annotated_MSA_20270502.pdf — pg 7).

2) E-signature confirmation: DocuSign acceptance is acceptable provided the audit trail is retained for minimum 7 years in the vendor portal. Vanessa, please record this requirement when provisioning.

3) PO ACK SLA: T+48 is fine, but Ops needs clear escalation path if PO ACK isn't received within 72 hours for revenue recognition cases (some buyers require strict timelines). Suggest we add an oracle clause in the order form: "Vendor shall ACK PO within X hours; failure to ACK within Y hours triggers escalation to account team." See proposed Order Form snippet in the attachment.

If MedSupply is comfortable with the mutual indemnity language and the e-signature retention requirement, we can prepare the final order form with the PO ACK SLA set to T+48 and an escalation line of T+72 to Ops.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Associate General Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | (650) 555-2301

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Holden <claire.holden@medsupply.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clarify signer provenance & PO ACK window for procurement portal registration

Claire —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We captured your answers and Markus's proposed compromises. Action items below (owner / ETA):

1) MedSupply to confirm W9 (Claire) / ETA: EOD Tue 5/3 — if you can send it we'll drop into the vendor packet.
2) Redwood legal to finalize mutual indemnity insert and order form snippet (Markus) / ETA: Wed 5/4 EOD.
3) Ops to configure Coupa signer matrix (Vanessa) / ETA: Thu 5/5 once we have final signer name (confirmed) and EDI prefix (MSPL).
4) Infra to ensure DocuSign audit export retention for 7 years (Mateo) / ETA: Thu 5/5 — please confirm storage location.

Claire — if you approve the approach on indemnity and retention, I'll queue the DocuSign envelope and loop in procurement contacts for Coupa provisioning. Also adding HubSpot and DocuSign links below so we can track.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/DEAL-8342
DocuSign preview: https://redwood.app/ds/abc123-docu-sign

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa / Markus —

All good from our side. W9 attached (PDF). We accept the mutual indemnity compromise and will sign with DocuSign. We confirm Coupa prefix MSPL and default PO ACK T+48 with escalation at T+72. Insurance cert included shows effective dates as noted.

Please go ahead with the DocuSign envelope. Once signed we'll coordinate with Tim (procurement) to finish Coupa provisioning — Tim's copied on earlier email — he will coordinate EDI feed and testing.

Best,
Claire
